task: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First stop, take a trip south. After that, make an attempt to travel west. And then, make an attempt to venture south. Then, make an attempt to venture west. With that accomplished, lift the keycard from the floor of the cellar. And once you've done that, you win!
